workstream: Owner-authorized zero-key/no-added-cost extractor audit of 603 distinct coffees from 201 US roasters
status: reconstructed production stable; fresh focused Node 22 tests and selected captured-source checks passed; awaiting final candidate snapshot/full corpus replay

recovery.cause: Executor returned an older filesystem snapshot; root recovered exact original WIP/upstream files, source captures and original frozen oracle bytes. Later code was reconstructed and freshly tested.

coverage_and_failure_categories.failure_category: compatible geographic evidence treated as a contradiction
coverage_and_failure_categories.repair: Reconcile exact country/region roles, complete source place segments, printed continent-country relations, explicit same-sentence region-country corroboration, middle-dot delimiters, and directional qualifiers. Remove a prefixed farm/cooperative only with independent exact selected-product role evidence. Preserve North-versus-South and unrelated regions as conflicts.
limits: No guessed regional hierarchy. Vesta Fresno and Tolima remain reviewable without a source join.
A genuine printed Central American versus Colombian claim remains a conflict.

coverage_and_failure_categories.failure_category: narrative or title country inferred from an unrelated meaning
coverage_and_failure_categories.repair: Reject country words inside named farms, historical coffee culture and national roast style; use title country only after explicit selected-product geography. Reject exact repeated product headings as region claims.
regressions: Explicit Brazil description on Ethiopia-titled synthetic Product
limits: Place names and political/cultural references are not automatically cultivation evidence.

coverage_and_failure_categories.failure_category: entity/list truncation, supported label variants and bounded cultivar grammar
coverage_and_failure_categories.repair: Decode entities before label separation; split semicolons only before explicit next labels; preserve full cultivar lists and accent/case equivalents; add Tree variety and safe terminal-period captions; extract named parenthetical and Oxford-comma cultivars and explicit processed-cultivar statements.
limits: An unrecognized botanical name without explicit label is retained in source facts, not guessed.
Generic flavor or street/barrel names cannot supply cultivars.

coverage_and_failure_categories.failure_category: coarse dropdown normalization loses literal processing or conflates blend components
coverage_and_failure_categories.repair: Retain literal processing detail, normalize explicit wet/dry and pulped-natural methods, recognize bounded current-coffee processing prose, and use Other/Unknown for explicit component mixtures. Preserve explicit caption over a less precise narrative fallback across endpoints.
regressions: 50% naturally processed Yellow Catuai and 50% honey processed Mondo Novo
Explicit Honey versus narrative anaerobic detail
limits: Decaffeination method alone does not establish washed/natural cultivation process.
Contradictory explicit processing captions remain withheld for review.

coverage_and_failure_categories.failure_category: farms, names, numerical metrics and narrative clauses mixed into one producer
coverage_and_failure_categories.repair: Keep farm separately; prefer a named explicit producer over a farm fallback; reject adjacent relationship-year and numeric count contamination; support bounded named-grower grammar and actual collective groups; record narrative provenance so explicit endpoint evidence can refine it.
regressions: Finca Costa Rica owned by Faver Ninco
limits: A group count or ambiguous broad sourcing sentence is not a named producer.
No arbitrary substring matching to reconcile incompatible producer identities.

coverage_and_failure_categories.failure_category: harvest/lot facts confused with generic marketing, publication dates or instructions
coverage_and_failure_categories.repair: Read literal harvest and lot labels, exact lot numbers, and source title identifiers; keep multiple source claims reviewable; reject generic Single Origin/Blend lot labels and shipping/harvest instructions.
limits: Micro-lot branding, series names and undated marketing are not automatically a canonical release.
Publication date, SKU and URL year do not establish harvest.

coverage_and_failure_categories.failure_category: source scope hides legitimate stories or leaks unrelated content
coverage_and_failure_categories.repair: Use bounded structural scanning, controlled hidden panels, precise related/review exclusions, narrow malformed-tag recovery, and fake-element/attribute guards. Quarantine a corroborated foreign coffee cohort while preserving raw source facts marked disputed.
regressions: Be Bright story behind malformed header
GloryCloud decaf description containing Kenya AB
Related product and review removal with current-story resumption
Fake meta markup and oversized malformed structure negatives
limits: Resource caps remain and truncation is disclosed.
Mixed source identity is quarantined only with positive corroboration, not broad heuristics.

coverage_and_failure_categories.failure_category: HTML, JSON, endpoint and meta fallbacks erase stronger evidence
coverage_and_failure_categories.repair: Bind metadata descriptions to exact canonical/OG URL and equivalent product title/brand; parse explicit labels before prose; preserve field-level narrative provenance; retain both competing raw claims and respect final conflicts.
regressions: Full HTML details preserved after endpoint enrichment
limits: Exact public endpoint and bounded shared-deadline rules remain in force.
A richer source-facts export is not the same as a reviewed canonical value.
